description: Mediation Boards Commission - Appointed of the Mediators.
reasoning: This gazette notification contains appointments to Mediation Boards (specifically for the Hikkaduwa Mediation Board in Galle District), which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves the appointment of mediators (including Chairman, Vice Chairman, and Members) by the Mediation Boards Commission under the Ministry of Justice, making it a judicial administration matter rather than a general government personnel change.
